freeze_rule: Freeze and content-address the immutable pre-run wave registration and an empty attempt-ledger genesis before the first observation; append terminal attempt entries during the wave without changing the pre-run registration.
wave_registry_required_content: opaque wave_id used identically as result experiment_id, plus experiment phase
controller, schema, benchmark, rubric, authority, oracle, production-command, projection, environment, model, tool, prompt-wrapper, provider, reviewer-pool, and timeout locks
case registrations binding every case ID to historical base commit/tree, task hash/bytes, and time/order allocation
a sealed variant-set document binding the eligible variant byte hashes and provenance receipts, stored separately from its public commitment
a sealed arm-key document binding anonymous labels to registered variants, stored separately from its pre-run commitment
planned case and arm order commitment

arm-key-blind reviewer/custodian/integrity/tooling-adjudicator allocator contract, role pools, workload cap, independent seed-custodian attestation, entropy receipt, and seed commitment with timestamps
Variant B firewall receipt for controlled A/B
attempt_entry_required_content: opaque attempt_id, run_id, blinded_candidate_id, pair_id when controlled A/B, case ID, attempt number, and initial/replacement role
previous attempt-entry hash and replacement target when applicable
wave, case-registration, planned-order, sealed-variant-set, and arm-key commitments
anonymous-ID generation receipt and exact identity equality with the later result/review packet
start registration timestamp before process launch
terminal disposition and immutable result-record hash or explicit not-started infrastructure disposition
attempt_ledger_rules: Append entries through a hash chain; never delete, reorder, relabel, or overwrite an attempt.
Register an attempt before provider contact, workspace exposure, or task launch.
A controlled pair shares one opaque pair_id and one pair-attempt number.
Task-quality failures and timeouts are accepted scored observations and never retried.

A fresh agent replacement with attempt_number=2 is permitted only when the first attempt failed before any model output, agent filesystem mutation, or candidate-dependent signal was observable; a second pre-output failure cancels the case.

After model output or candidate mutation exists, never launch a replacement agent. A post-output validator/reviewer infrastructure failure may re-execute that failed stage once against the identical immutable captured candidate when no protected content was exposed; otherwise cancel the case.
Any protected-content exposure, untrustworthy capture, or candidate-dependent invalidation that prevents same-candidate evaluation cancels the case/pair rather than resampling the model.
If either controlled arm is cancelled or invalidated after output, append terminal discarded entries for both sides and retain neither; never selectively retain or replace the other arm.
A replacement entry cites every discarded attempt it replaces and uses fresh workspace, process, cache, Codex home, anonymous label, and provider request.
Publish the immutable pre-run registration, full append-only ledger, all invalid/not-started records, final chain head, allocator seed opening, and arm-key opening after the wave freezes.

commitment_canonicalization.serialization: recursively sort object keys by ECMAScript default Array.prototype.sort, JSON.stringify with no whitespace, append one LF, encode UTF-8
